data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'd-r-s', meaning 'to serve'. A servant of Allah. The name Idrees carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Idrees usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: إدريس
in_arabic.meaning: من أعلى الجبال أو من ينزل من المطر
in_arabic.long_meaning: إدريس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: من أعلى الجبال، أو من ينزل من المطر، ويعتبر إدريس عليه السلام أحد الأنبياء المذكورين في القرآن الكريم، وقد ورد ذكره في سورة الحجر، وهو معروف بأنه أول من خط على الأرض بالقلم

in_urdu.name: ادریس
in_urdu.meaning: اعلیٰ کوہ سے یا بارش سے اترنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ادریس ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے اعلیٰ کوہ سے یا بارش سے اترنے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک نبی کے نام سے وابستہ ہے جو قرآن کریم میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ الحجر میں

in_english.name: Idrees
in_english.meaning: a prophet's name, meaning highest mountain or descending
in_english.long_meaning: Idrees is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'highest mountain' or 'descending'. In Islamic tradition, Idrees (also known as Enoch) is considered a prophet mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Hijr. He is revered for his wisdom, piety, and role as a scribe, being the first to write with a pen

data.cultural_impact: The name Idris, or Idrees, is a renowned name within Islamic culture with various historical and Quranic references. Idris is believed to be the first great prophet of pre-Islamic times in Islamic tradition, mentioned in several Hadiths (sayings of the Prophet Muhammad). He was regarded as a righteous and wise leader who was also a great scholar of the interpretations of religious laws. The name Idris is still used in the Arab world and Muslims communities around the world.

This name serves as a constant reminder for the one bearing it to adhere to the Islamic teachings and fulfill their religious obligations. Thus, the name Idris is an embodiment of obedience, devotion, and dedication to Allah.
